text: This activity explains viewing system glossary. Use the viewing system methodically and make a documented, accountable decision. Select each panel to work through the approved practice.
Automatic Diamond DetectionA software aid that flags possible objects for the Viewer’s attention. It supports the Viewer but does not replace human judgement.
An image-processing technique that makes edges and surface textures appear raised or recessed.
The Internet Protocol address used to connect the viewing station to the image server.
Image Viewing SystemThe software used to examine and process Scannex images.
The colours or shades of grey assigned to different X-ray densities. Changing the palette changes how the same image data appears.
An image-processing mode that sharpens detail and emphasises edges.
You have reviewed ADD, Emboss, IP Address, IVS. Apply the approved procedure consistently, record what matters and escalate uncertainty rather than improvising.
